items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: He said Sam was in the middle of the year. He played with Bill Nassar.

ctx.x: He played with him. He played with him. He played with him. I don't know a fella by the name of Bill Jackson played Papa Celestein when he played with him. I used to hear him talking about Bill Jackson. He played Sam.
He said Sam was in the middle of the year. He played with Bill Nassar.
Well, I don't say a fella by the name of Bill Jackson.
